title: Oman GDELT events lead Brent
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Oman GDELT event count 20d z-score > 1.5 marks Gulf tension (not diplomacy) and leads Brent higher by 2 days (+); trade long BZ=F 3d [gdelt.omn.events -> finance.BZ=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0006)

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.omn.events rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long BZ=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 2 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Oman GDELT conflict-event count 20d z-score > 1.0 (tension only, excluding diplomacy) leads Brent higher by 2 days (+) and should beat the all-events rule out-of-sample; trade long BZ=F 2d [gdelt.omn.conflict_events -> finance.BZ=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0105)
